geopolitics_summary: Russian hybrid threats to Romanian offshore gas; Trump tariff pause; Iran sanctions escalation; geopolitical risk to EU gas supply and LNG arb mechanics.

themes.headline: Romanian offshore gas platform targeted by drone; Moscow blamed by EU
themes.why_it_matters: Direct threat to Black Sea gas production (Romania key EU supplier). Escalation risk could disrupt physical gas flows or elevate storage build urgency; TTF risk via supply shock.

themes.headline: US natural gas production forecast to hit record 122.5 Bcf/d in 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Record US gas output increases LNG export capacity. Higher US LNG supply into global market strengthens TTF arb mechanics (lower European LNG import prices), pressuring power via merit order displacement.

themes.headline: Trump escalates Iran sanctions; threatens economic strangulation
themes.why_it_matters: Tighter Iran sanctions reduce oil supply, raising crude prices. Higher crude inflation pressures European coal/gas switching economics and fuel input costs for power generation.

themes.headline: Marine heat waves intensifying across Europe; climate drivers of extreme weather
themes.why_it_matters: Persistent ocean warming elevates cooling demand and wildfire risk, increasing thermal plant outages (availability impact). Direct demand shock and supply constraint on DA/intraday power curves.

themes.headline: Longer Permian wells boost US oil and gas output; super-lateral drilling expansion
themes.why_it_matters: Enhanced Permian production (gas and oil) reinforces US LNG export growth. Indirect: sustained low US gas costs support higher LNG volumes to Europe, pressuring TTF via global LNG arb.

watchlist: Romanian offshore gas platform security escalation; physical disruption risk.
US LNG export scheduling/capacity utilization updates; global TTF arb pressure.
Iran sanctions enforcement timelines; crude price trajectory and coal/gas switching.
European marine heat wave / wildfire impacts on thermal generation; outage notices.
